scope: All frontend src .ts/.tsx files, including unit tests and test helpers, plus every E2E TypeScript file, Playwright configuration and the iPad Safari test runner. Declaration files are outside the inventory. Reviewed means full source inspection across this review, including unchanged first-pass implementation files; it is not proof of defect absence.
exclusions: Only static translation catalogs remain explicitly excluded within this inventory. Stylesheets, image/font/vector assets, declarations, non-test tooling scripts, and backend files as an independent audit remain outside it. Relevant API contracts and tests were traced as needed.
limitations: No live LINE login or friend picker, live wallet transaction, device sensor or physical Pencil session.

All frontend unit/E2E test sources were inspected, but neither the complete browser suite nor the iPad simulator runner was executed. Focused Chromium/WebKit runs cover the cut, cookie-loss, and Web Locks reproductions. No physical-device memory profile.
Mutation experiments test selected claims only; this is not exhaustive mutation testing. Passing characterization tests reproduce defects, not fixes.
Hashes record inspected contents. Changes after this audit need separate review.
External dependencies were not audited internally.
